**Visualizing color relationships**

I’m considering a setup where horizontal rows are filled with bars, and between these bars, there are vertical colored blocks. Each vertical block will fill with color corresponding to the horizontal bar until it reaches the next bar. I also want to add a lower marker that matches the color of the last bar and ensure the top edge reflects the color of the topmost bar. This way, there’s a consistent color flow throughout the visual.

**Evaluating demo requests**
